title: Abaye bar Nazi, father-in-law of Ravina

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Bava Kamma 115a according to the Rif’s reading; see the entry Avimi bar Nazi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The locator and name form are attributed specifically to the Rif’s reading.

The William Davidson digital paragraph of Bava Kamma 115a has Avimi bar Nazi, Ravina’s father-in-law. Hyman’s heading instead gives Abaye and attributes his form to the Rif. The Rif has not been freshly collated here. Both supplied forms and the cross-reference are preserved without adopting a correction, binding its target, or importing the financial episode.
